::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 30 1884  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell.
:::

Dear [Mrs Suckling](people/person_1380.qmd)

Would you be so kind as to send the prospectus or at any rate some papers about the [Band of Mercy](organizations/other_265.qmd) to [Mr Streatfield](people/person_2438.qmd) the clergyman of Kingsworthy (Winchester)  I am afraid I dont know his Christian name, but he seemed much inclined to join it with his schoolchildren, and I promised him to ask you to send him the papers

yours truly

C M Yonge
